acceptance_criteria.statement: A Plan's slides can be grouped under named phases, and the reader shows those groups in order.
A reader can tell from a Plan which of its work can be done at the same time.

content.statement: As a developer, I can read a Plan as a slide deck organized by phase, so I understand the work in the order it can be done and what can happen in parallel.
content.title: Read a Plan phase by phase

state.reason: Verified against the code and tests on 2026-11-02. Slides group under named sections in order, and the Tasks view says a phase runs in parallel.
